title: Game Vision
summary: Defines the project identity, genre, platforms, Unreal Engine 5 direction, player fantasy, design pillars, differentiators, audience and production boundaries.

title: Core Gameplay Loop
summary: Maps the explore-discover-prepare-fight-earn-improve cycle across sessions, long-term progression and rewards.

title: Combat System
summary: Specifies the real-time third-person combat model, four-character party, swapping, actions, resources, targeting, statuses, readability and encounter logic.

title: Character Gameplay System
summary: Defines how element, profession, role, weapon, statistics, abilities, talents and relationships combine into a distinct playable identity.

title: Elements and Reactions
summary: Defines the seven standard elements, special powers, aura rules and the asymmetric reaction matrix that can alter enemies, terrain and positioning.

title: Progression System
summary: Organizes account, character, equipment, skill, profession, mastery and regional progression while protecting accessibility and experimentation.

title: Gacha System
summary: Defines acquisition purpose, rarities, banners, pity, guarantees, duplicates, free acquisition and transparency without making random pulls mandatory for core content.

title: Economy and Resources
summary: Maps currencies, sources, sinks, materials and economic guardrails so progression remains understandable and sustainable.

title: Exploration System
summary: Defines exploration fantasy, regional identity, traversal, discoveries, points of interest, rewards and how world knowledge feeds progression.

title: Missions and Activities
summary: Structures story missions, side content, character activities, recurring activities, objectives and rewards.

title: Dungeons and Bosses
summary: Defines dungeon roles, encounter structure, boss identity, readability, progression value and replayable challenge.

title: Equipment and Items
summary: Defines weapons, equipment, consumables, rarity, acquisition, progression and inventory rules.

title: Social and Multiplayer
summary: Frames cooperative and social systems, communication, boundaries and the conditions under which online features support rather than replace the RPG.

title: Endgame and Live Content
summary: Defines post-story goals, recurring challenges, content cadence and live-service boundaries for long-term play.
sourceFile: Game Design/14 - Endgame and Live Content.docx

title: Rewards and Retention
summary: Defines reward philosophy, cadence, motivation, return loops and safeguards against manipulative retention design.

title: Difficulty and Balance
summary: Defines difficulty goals, encounter scaling, accessibility, telemetry, power creep controls and balance methodology.

title: World and Lore Index
summary: Acts as the master index for canon, disputed, proposed, secret and production-sensitive worldbuilding material.
sourceFile: World and Lore/00 - World and Lore Index.docx

title: World Overview
summary: Introduces the world premise, the four major nations, neutral powers, geopolitical relationships and the unstable peace of the current era.

title: Cosmology Origins and Deities
summary: Explains Will, the Master of Birds, the four Deities of Judgment and the cosmological roots behind Judgment, Forgiveness, Revenge and Wisdom.
sourceFile: World and Lore/02 - Cosmology Origins and Deities.docx

title: Historical Timeline
summary: Organizes the history from origin through the current era, preserving public, disputed, secret, lost and restricted layers of knowledge.

title: Nations and Territories
summary: Details the identities, governments, cultures, symbols, geography, cities and contradictions of the major nations and territories.
sourceFile: World and Lore/04 - Nations and Territories.docx

title: Factions and Organizations
summary: Profiles institutions, clans and organizations by structure, ideology, relationships, narrative role and control of information.
sourceFile: World and Lore/05 - Factions and Organizations.docx

title: Cultures Politics and Justice
summary: Explores daily life, legitimacy, justice systems, political currents, material culture and contradictions within each society.
sourceFile: World and Lore/06 - Cultures Politics and Justice.docx

title: Locations Landmarks and Dungeons
summary: Catalogues locations by production priority and connects visual identity, narrative purpose and gameplay relevance.
sourceFile: World and Lore/07 - Locations Landmarks and Dungeons.docx

title: Creatures Ecology and Threats
summary: Defines creature taxonomy, origin, ecology, sapience, social relationships and the difference between fauna, peoples and enemies.
sourceFile: World and Lore/08 - Creatures Ecology and Threats.docx

title: Vertical Slice Index
summary: Central index for the playable proof of concept and its production documentation.

title: Vertical Slice Vision and Scope
summary: Defines what the polished slice must prove and which full-product systems are intentionally out of scope.
sourceFile: Vertical Slice/01 - Vertical Slice Vision and Scope.docx

title: Player Journey and Demo Flow
summary: Maps a 20–30 minute reviewer journey through nine beats, teaching mechanics through play while escalating curiosity into confrontation.
sourceFile: Vertical Slice/02 - Player Journey and Demo Flow.docx

title: Feature and Content Matrix
summary: Controls scope by ranking every slice feature as MUST, SHOULD, COULD or CUT and tying it to pillars, dependencies and evidence.
sourceFile: Vertical Slice/03 - Feature and Content Matrix.docx

title: Playable Content and Encounter Brief
summary: Defines the proposed playable cast, region, encounters, teaching roles and combat proof points for the slice.
sourceFile: Vertical Slice/04 - Playable Content and Encounter Brief.docx

title: Narrative Beats and Script Plan
summary: Structures the slice mystery around incomplete explanations, environmental clues, character perspectives and a truth shift without overexposing the wider lore.
